$comment: Machine contract the agent network consumes. The AI produces DATA ONLY: theme + tokens + content. It never touches components or CSS. See AGENTS.md.

decisionRubric.rule: A brief that names the template explicitly WINS (record 'pinned by brief'); otherwise score all 4 and pick the highest. Tie or thin brief => ask for confirmation. Never switch template over a colour nuance (that is a token).

tokenContract.$comment: Tokens the AI may edit. The rest (accentSoft, line, muted) are derived via color-mix and are off-limits.

accent.desc: Primary brand colour (buttons, kickers, highlighted prices)

budget.vibe: Dense OTA-style, search + price up top, badges

business.vibe: Clean grid, utility bar, location + efficiency

resort.vibe: Immersive, full-bleed imagery, experiences, large radii

pages.$comment: Page inventory. booking is NOT a page (the plugin handles it). The guests/dates/rooms selector is embedded in landing and room detail.

nav.$comment: nav.cta is an i18n KEY SUFFIX rendered as t('cta.<value>') — only these values are valid; free text ('reservar') prints the raw key in the header. The template localises it per locale.

booking.$comment: provider 'mirai' mounts @mirai/core's <Finder> for real (core assets + repository instance injected by the layout). propertyId must be the NUMERIC Mirai id from the brief; empty or non-numeric falls back to the demo property 100379008. Other providers render the inert mock until their embed lands in BookingWidget.

i18n.localeNote: scout picks site.locales from the hotel's target MARKET (light research at intake), constrained to supportedLocales. A market locale outside this set is a template gap to flag for forge, never a silent drop.

bindingCatalogue.$comment: The agent fills exactly these fields per page; [] means a repeating collection. OPTIONAL per-page SEO: any enabled page may ship pages/<page>.<lang>.json with seo{title,description,keywords}; without it the template falls back to '<PageName> — <home seo.description>' localized.
amenities: amenities[].category (budget groups its checklist by it)
legal: legal[].body — file `legal/<slug>.<lang>.md` — slug from the filename stem, SAME stem across locales (the switcher and hreflang swap only the locale) (VERBATIM hotel-supplied text — privacy/terms/cookies; agents place it, NEVER draft legal copy; no text => no pages, footer shows no legal links)

guardrails: The AI produces DATA, not layout code.
Never edit files under components/, base tokens, or CSS.
All content is validated at build (Zod); invalid data fails the build with a clear error.
One hotel = one template. Never mix two templates' structures.
Missing photo => use the Image component placeholder, never break the layout.
Legal copy (privacy/terms) is hotel-supplied VERBATIM — an agent never drafts, translates-creatively, or invents legal text.
